name: tripartite motif containing 33
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TRIM33 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase TRIM33. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
